referenceFunction.generalComment:
This dataset represents the supply of 1 kilowatt hour of electricity in a residence, by hydrogen combustion in a CHP. The hydrogen is produced by Steam Methane Reforming, with CCS, with natural gas from Switzerland as feedstock. Electricity conversion efficiency [% LHV input]: 39.4%. LHV [kWh/kg]: 33.33. Market price [Euro/MJ]: 0.03. Synthesis efficiency [% LHV input]: 0%. Total cap. Input-related [kW]: 443.9. CO2 biogenic share [%]: 0%. Power [kW]: 200. Lifetime [years]: 19.51. Annual operation [hours]: 4100. Allocation factor: 0.92. On-site storage loss [%]: 0. Use loss [%]: 0.5. For more information, refer to: Sacchi, R. and Bauer, C. LCA of Power-to-X processes and applications in the residential sector. Paul Scherrer Institut, 2023. Source: Sacchi, R. and Bauer, C. LCA of Power-to-X processes and applications in the residential sector. Paul Scherrer Institut, 2023.
